customer.business: Sora: QR table ordering for South African restaurants, works alongside the existing POS
customer.target: Owners or managers of sit-down restaurants in South Africa who decide on software spend
customer.where: South African cities and towns (Gauteng, Western Cape, KZN)

segments.name: Franchisee of a national chain (e.g. one family-restaurant branch)
Small local group (2-5 restaurants or cafes)
Upmarket destination venue (wine farm, tourist area)

behaviours.name: Cost-cutter
behaviours.how: Questions every monthly subscription; margins are thin and load-shedding and food costs already squeeze them.

behaviours.name: Loyal to their POS
behaviours.how: Trusts their POS vendor and would rather wait for the POS company to add a feature than add another system.

behaviours.name: Staff-shortage pain
behaviours.how: Struggles to hire and keep waiters; busy nights mean slow service and lost tables.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Already tried a QR menu or online ordering and likes trying new tools.

behaviours.name: Old-school hospitality
behaviours.how: Believes guests want a waiter, not a phone; worries tech feels impersonal.

behaviours.name: Needs proof first
behaviours.how: Wants to see it working at a restaurant they know, or a free trial, before paying.

behaviours.name: Franchise rules bound
behaviours.how: Needs head office approval for any customer-facing system or menu change.

objections: Another monthly subscription when margins are already tight
Will it work with my POS, or will my staff have to type orders in twice?
My older customers want a waiter and a paper menu
What happens when the signal or Wi-Fi drops during a busy service, or during load-shedding?
Who are you? A new company with no restaurants using it yet
Customers might order and leave without paying
Head office or my POS company may already offer this
Setting it up and training staff takes time I don't have
habits: you do the books yourself on Monday mornings
your busiest service is Friday and Saturday night
you lost two waiters to other jobs this year
you run a generator or inverter for load-shedding
your POS company's sales rep visits twice a year
most of your regulars are over 45

pitch:
Sora, a South African start-up: diners scan a QR code at the table, browse your menu on their phone and order; orders appear instantly on a kitchen screen.
Works on the phones and tablets you already have, alongside your existing POS (staff still ring orders up on the POS for now; direct POS links are planned).
Includes a "call waiter" button, live order tracking for diners, pay-now or pay-after-the-meal (you choose, to stop walk-outs), sold-out switch and a simple owner dashboard.
Pro plan with QR ordering: R699 a month, no commission on orders. We set it up and train your staff on site. Online card payment providers charge their own fees.
Cancel any month. New company: no restaurants live yet; we are looking for our first pilot restaurants.
